We inspire guests with End Stage Kidney Disease to alter their perspective towards life through education, encouragement and empowerment.

Aashayein

An exclusive annual event with a whole lot of fun and games where dialysis guests, nephrologists, clinical nutritionists, and industry experts discuss how one can lead the life they want and reduce dialysis to being just a small part of life.

Learn More

Dialysis Olympiad

Modelled on the Olympic Games with sports, diet and fitness education and motivational talks on how one can lead an impactful life even while on dialysis.
